display_long_description:
Step into the world of clinical dermatology through immersive virtual reality. This educational VR application simulates a doctor-patient consultation focused on the diagnosis of leprosy (Hansen’s disease), designed specifically for medical students and healthcare trainees.

Observe realistic patient interviews, visual examination of skin lesions, and doctor-patient interactions that reflect real-world clinical practices. The simulation helps users learn to identify symptoms, understand the diagnostic process, and improve communication skills in a safe, controlled environment.

Key Features:
- Interactive VR scenario featuring a dermatological consultation
- High-quality 3D models showing typical leprosy skin manifestations
- Realistic dialogue between doctor and patient
- Ideal for medical education and clinical skill development
- Designed for Oculus Quest with intuitive user controls

Whether you're preparing for clinical rotations or enhancing your knowledge in dermatology, this application offers a compelling, hands-on learning experience in virtual reality.
